title: Threat Level for Public Transport Facilities in Singapore
what_it_is: Threat Level for Public Transport Facilities in Singapore

sections.label: Terrorism threat to public transport
sections.summary: The terrorism threat to Singapore remains high, and LTA works with Home Team agencies to customise public transport security measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the past two years, there have been attacks against commuters and subway trains globally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The terrorism threat to Singapore remains high with the possibility of a terrorist attack against our public transport facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been working closely with the Home Team agencies to customise specific security measures for public transport, based on the prevailing threat level.

sections.label: Tampines West MRT terror exercise
sections.summary: A January exercise at Tampines West MRT station simulated a terrorist attack, with over 120 officers and public transport workers participating.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For example, in January this year, a contingency exercise that simulated a terrorist attack was conducted at Tampines West Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station, as part of the SGSecure movement to enhance the community's response to a terrorist attack.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: More than 120 officers from various agencies and public transport workers participated in this exercise, with the public transport workers and the community assisting the authorities with evacuation and first-aid.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Last year, in addition to such exercises and trial of security screening measures, the Public Transport Security Committee, an interagency body led by LTA, produced a video to show how commuters can get themselves to safety while helping others in the event of a terrorist attack on a train.

sections.label: LTA and MHA security seminars
sections.summary: LTA and MHA conduct quarterly protective security awareness seminars for public transport workers, with more programmes and exercises to follow.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Beyond such ongoing efforts, LTA has partnered the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) to conduct quarterly protective security awareness seminars for public transport workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We will continue to conduct relevant programmes, training and exercises to enable the public transport community to respond, help themselves and others during a security incident.
